name: trade.xprimeflow/mcp
title: X PrimeFlow
description: Read-only market and on-chain data: BTC and ETH network stats, liquidations, Hyperliquid traders

tools.name: btc_network_metrics
tools.description: Daily Bitcoin network series computed by X PrimeFlow on its own Bitcoin full node: hash rate, difficulty, transaction count, unique addresses, coin days destroyed, NVT ratio, miner revenue in BTC and fee rates. Returns the latest values or one series with up to 365 daily points, with asOf and age.

metric.description: One daily series. Omit to get the latest value of every series.

days.description: How many latest daily points to return (1–365).

tools.name: eth_network_metrics
tools.description: Daily Ethereum series computed by X PrimeFlow on its own execution (geth) and beacon (lighthouse) nodes: ETH burned, base fee, gas, blob fees, validators and staked ETH, stablecoin supply on L1 and ETH held in L2 bridges. Returns the latest values or one series with up to 365 daily points, with asOf and age.

metric.description: One daily series. Omit to get the latest value of every series.

days.description: How many latest daily points to return (1–365).

tools.name: onchain_liquidations
tools.description: Liquidations of perpetual positions on Hyperliquid and Helix (Injective) for one coin over the last 24 hours and 7 days: long and short USD totals, event counts and the largest liquidation. Each venue shows up to which time its feed has been read. Coins are those of the open liquidation summary: ETH, SOL, BNB, AVAX, ATOM, INJ, TIA, DYDX, ASTER. BTC is not part of this open summary.

tools.name: hyperliquid_trader_board
tools.description: Hyperliquid traders ranked by X PrimeFlow by how copyable their trading was over the last 30 days, recomputed from raw fills: realised PnL of closed round trips, win rate against payoff, profit factor, drawdown of the PnL curve, tenure and three copyability checks. The venue leaderboard supplies only the list of addresses. The board is rebuilt every few hours.

limit.description: How many top rows to return (1–25).

tools.name: sec_filings_insiders
tools.description: Company filings with the SEC parsed by X PrimeFlow: 8-K events and 13D/13G stakes, Form 4 insider transactions, and crypto treasury holdings reported in filings, for a tracked universe of crypto-related and large US companies. Summary views need no ticker; per-company views take a ticker.

view.description: filings_summary and insiders_summary cover all tracked companies; filings, insiders and treasury need symbol.

symbol.description: US ticker in upper case, for example COIN or MSTR.

tools.name: sec_13f_holdings
tools.description: Quarterly 13F holdings of institutional managers, matched by X PrimeFlow: biggest inflows and outflows by stock, the largest filers, holders of one stock, positions of one manager, and dataset coverage. Long positions above the reporting threshold only.

view.description: holders needs symbol; fund needs cik.

cik.description: SEC CIK number of the manager, digits only.

tools.name: macro_cot_m2
tools.description: CFTC Commitments of Traders for CME Bitcoin futures (weekly positions of leveraged funds, asset managers, dealers and small traders) and US M2 money supply from the Federal Reserve H.6 release, monthly and weekly.

series.description: cme-cot = weekly COT rows; us-m2 = monthly M2; us-m2-weekly = weekly M2.

points.description: How many latest rows or points to return.

tools.name: chain_overview
tools.description: State of the Ethereum, Gno.land, AtomOne and Provenance networks read by X PrimeFlow from its own nodes: overview, network, staking, validators, governance and other sections. Parts that were answered by a node we may not redistribute are held back and listed.

section.description: Section. Ethereum: overview, network, burn, staking, stablecoins, l2, coverage. Gno: overview, network, validators, governance, registry, gnoswap, pools, infrastructure. AtomOne: overview, network, staking, validators, governance, ibc, photon, treasury, fees. Provenance: overview, network, staking, validators, governance, ibc, assets, infrastructure.

tools.name: bonynode_validator_status
tools.description: Whether the BonyNode validator is in the active set on the chains it validates, with its status as read from the chains.

chain.description: Optional chain id or name to filter, for example cosmoshub.

tools.name: data_sources_status
tools.description: Where X PrimeFlow data comes from and how fresh each collector is, plus reference lists: indicator definitions, the coin-to-sector taxonomy and real-world-asset categories.

topic.description: sources = freshness of every collector; indicators = indicator definitions; sectors = coin sectors; rwa = real-world-asset categories.

category.description: For topic=sources: list every source of one category instead of only those not ok.
